Name: Tileman Challenge
Author: SpicyKai
Description:
***Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and similar Mods***

This is SpicyKai's Tileman Challenge!

Every location in SV is populated with custom tiles that prevent you from moving through, or using them... Until you purchase them of course!


There are 3 levels of difficulty for the mod which can be changed in the config.json file of my mod. (There is a separate config file for each save as well)

Level 0  - Easiest difficulty, each tile will cost $1, and will increase to $2(and so on) after a few thousand tiles.

Level 1 - This is the default difficulty of the challenge. at every 10X tiles, the price increases(0-10 -> $1, 11-100 -> $2, 101-1000 -> $3,  1001-10000 -> $4, 10001-??? -> $5)

Level 2 Hardest difficulty, every purchased tile increase the price by $1 (Is this even possible? ;) )


There is a bit more customization available in the config.json


DoCollision: Does the mod check if you collide with tiles? Mark this as false if you don't want too limited

AllowPlayerPlacement: Lets the player do things in tile spots. Mark this as true to allow yourself the ability to hoe, plant, and place furniture my tiles.

TilePrice: How much each tile costs to purchase. Mark this as other integers to have a different start (default is 1)

TilePriceRaise:How much the price of tile increases with each purchase. This is for Difficulty 0, the default raise is very low, but you can do what you want.

CavernsExtra:How many extra levels of Skull Caverns do you want to have tiles in? The default goes down to floor 100



You can find my code [url=https://github.com/spicykai/StardewValley-Mods/tree/main/Tileman]here[/url]



This mod was inspired by Setlled's Runescape Tileman challenge on YouTube, Check him out [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Settledrs/featured]here.[/url]
